title: Now on Moreta: send money to friends
summary: Moreta users can now send and receive money instantly with no fees. Find your Moreta tag, share your QR code and pay friends in a few taps.
body_markdown:
Splitting dinner or paying a friend back? You can now send and receive money between Moreta users instantly, with no fees. It works for every Moreta user, wherever you signed up. Update the app to get it.


## Your Moreta tag is ready


Your tag, like @alex, is how friends find and pay you. We've already given you one. Update the app to see it, change it if you'd like, and start sharing it.


You also get your own QR code. Open My code and tap Share code to send it to a friend, or let them scan it from your screen.


## How to pay a friend


1. Open Send and enter your friend's Moreta tag, or scan their code.


2. Enter the amount and tap Review. Fees show as Free.


3. Confirm. The money arrives in their Moreta account, and they can use it right away.


Your friend needs a Moreta account to receive money. If they don't have one yet, send them the app.


## Send to banks and wallets too


With


[Moreta Send](https://moretapay.com/features/remittance)


, you can also transfer money to bank accounts in EUR, GBP, CAD, USD, VND, PHP, BRL, COP and PEN, or to a Solana crypto wallet. More destinations are on the way.
